Based on my search on the Epic Games store, I found a popular Fortnite game called "Fortnite Chapter 4 Season 3" available for free. Additionally, there is an application called "Unreal Editor for Fortnite" that allows you to design, develop, and publish games and experiences directly into Fortnite.

As for free games that you can play together, I found a game called "Core" which is a multiverse of free games to play and worlds to explore. It offers thousands of Unreal-powered games from every genre and also allows you to create and earn from your own games. There is also a game development platform called "HELIX" that provides everything you need to easily create and host your own immersive multiplayer 3D experiences.

These games should provide you and your friends with enjoyable gaming experiences. Have fun playing together!
